entities.summary: The Italian National Agency for the protection and assistance of the Deaf (ENS) is the oldest and principal national association representing the deaf community in Italy. Founded in 1932, its mission is to protect the rights of deaf individuals, promote their social integration, autonomy, and full human development. As of 16 June 2022, it is registered in the National Single Register of the Third Sector as a social promotion association. ENS is also a member of the World Federation of the Deaf (WFD) and European Union of the Deaf.
